g.text: Each frame is rendered (Cycles, 1024×768) and the subject mesh is projected into it,

text.style: font-size: 4.8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans'; fill: #1f2126

g.text: so its box, bearing, elevation and occupancy are exact — no detector, no annotator. A frame can serve

text.style: font-size: 4.8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans'; fill: #1f2126

g.text: as a goal if occupancy is 10–80 % and ≥ 35 % of the body is visible.
